title: LS1 fix round 1: add the five acceptance tests for the compaction brief, hook text, plan size nag and compact hook
spec:
Fix round of T-1592. Its commit 3b26f12 on task/T-1592 implements planner_context.compact_brief, the new hook_message texts, the plan_max_chars nag, `planner-context --brief` and .claude/hooks/planner-compact.sh, but adds no tests, so the acceptance gate held it. (Its acceptance also named tests as File::Class::test, which the gate parses as a test called Class; this round uses the File::test form.)

Add these methods (unittest, inside the existing TestCase classes `PlannerContext` in tests/test_planner_context.py and `Hooks` in tests/test_hooks.py, following the fixtures already used there):
- test_compact_brief_now_section: plan.md with '## Now' then '## Other' yields the 'Session compacted; continue in place.' first line, only the Now section text, and the 'Full state: .orchestrator/plan.md' pointer line.
- test_compact_brief_fallback_and_cap: no Now section uses the file start; text over `limit` is cut at a newline and ends with '[cut; read .orchestrator/plan.md]'; missing plan.md yields 'plan.md missing; run the resume skill.'.
- test_hook_message_compact_in_place: the over-threshold and the after-handover messages both contain 'compacts in place' and neither contains 'f orch'.
- test_plan_size_nag: plan.md over plan_max_chars returns the nag line while tokens are below the threshold; plan_max_chars = 0 returns None.
- test_planner_compact_hook: running .claude/hooks/planner-compact.sh prints the brief for a Planner session, prints nothing for a task worker, and exits 0 when the orchestrator command fails.
If a test exposes a defect in 3b26f12, fix the code in scope. Existing tests in both files must still pass.
